content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6011: The clean water in the station is insufficient, please add water, Base station clean water tank is empty, insufficient water error despite a filled tank, showed the clean water tank is empty, saying that the Clean water is insufficient, water in the clean water tank is insufficient?
content.Content:
* 1. Inspect the components of the clean water tank itself. If there is water in the tank, remove it first: check if the sealing ring of the water outlet is installed correctly/is undamaged. If the seal ring is deformed or broken, please provide photos of the defect. 
2.If there are no abnormalities in the above steps (clean water tank components, base station sealing ring, installation), and the robot still displays error after reinstallation, it can be determined that there is a hardware problem with the base station.

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7031:Return failed, please clear the area around the station, Failed to return to the base station?
content.Content:
* 1.The robot is blocked by obstacles during the process of getting on the seat, so it cannot enter the station. Please check and clear the obstacles around the station to ensure that there is enough space around the station.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Ensure-adequate-space-around-the-base-station.png

* 2.It is recommended not to place the station on the carpet. The robot is more likely to slip or be blocked when it moves backwards on the carpet.
* 3.Please check whether the robot's swivel wheel is seriously entangled with hair. This may make it difficult for the robot to get onto the station. Please clean the hair on the swivel wheel and try again.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Check-robot-swivel-wheel-for-heavy-hair-entanglement.png
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-robot-swivel-wheel.mov

4. Check the surface and grooves of the robot's left and right wheels for sand, gravel, or oil stains. If there are, wipe them clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth. After cleaning, manually return the robot to the base station.

content.Title: What should I do if my Omni C20 T2280 reports an error 6012/6013: Sprinkler error？
content.Content:
Please try restarting the robot to see if the error is resolved. If the error persists after restarting, please try unplugging and replugging the base station power supply.



If the above steps still do not solve the problem,our engineering team has determined that this error is caused by a hardware malfunction. Please rest assured that if your product experiences a hardware issue while still under warranty, we will provide warranty service.

content.Content:
Please follow these troubleshooting steps:



1.Remove the dirty water reservoir and check if the roller is entangled with foreign objects---especially strings, data cables, plastic bags, hair, etc. Clean out any debris to ensure the roller rotates properly. (Note:Please refer the video below. If you hear a clicking sound, it indicates that the roller is properly installed.)

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-install-a-roller-mop-for-E25-E28.mp4



Tips:

Before starting a cleaning task, tidy up cables and wires in advance to prevent roller jams.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

content.Title: What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
content.Content:
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.

4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

* Check if your home network is set up as a dual-band network. You need to separate a 2.4GHz band for your devices to connect to. If you have multiple devices, you can use cross-location verification to eliminate the interference of location on device stability.

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 4011: Laser sensor may be blocked, or says “The sensor is blocked”?
content.Content:
1. The warping of the protective film will hinder the normal operation of the radar, so please make sure that the protective film on the surface of the top panel is removed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-the-protective-film.png

2. Remove foreign objects blocking the radar;

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects-blocking-the-radar.png

3. Please use cotton swabs and other flexible materials to wipe the radar transmitting and receiving holes.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/wipe-the-radar-transmitting-and-receiving-holes.png

* 2.Remove foreign objects blocking the radar.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects.png

这是 S1 Pro 的 EB1L 加清水异常，任务因此结束。请按以下步骤检查：
1. 取下基站清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好，用手电查看箱内水管是否损坏；加水至 MAX 后重新放稳。
2. 检查机器人进水口是否有杂物，用纸巾或棉签清理；再检查基站注水口橡胶塞是否损坏或缺失。
3. 资料要求固件为 7.0.143 或以上。请确认当前版本。 [1]

response.reply:
EB1L means the S1 Pro stopped because of a clean-water filling error. Please check:
1. Check the clean-water tank outlet seal and internal pipe, refill to MAX and reseat it.
2. Clear debris from the robot water inlet and inspect the station inlet rubber plug.
3. The guide specifies firmware 7.0.143 or later. Please check your version. [1]

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

response.reply:
Exact model and error-code references:
This issue is caused by radar interference affecting communication between the base station and the robot, which prevents the base station task from starting.



If your robot is still within the warranty period, we would be happy to offer you a replacement.

Small or thin floor mats are light in weight and are easily hit by the front of the sweeper or lifted up by the side brush, and may even roll up to the roller. It is recommended to fix the corners of the floor mat with nano glue or set a restricted area;



https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-set-up-an-no-go-zone-for-E25-E28-1.mp4


Basic troubleshooting steps
1. Confirm basic connection information
- Confirm the networking steps are correct and the entered Wi-Fi password is accurate; suggest the customer copy the password from the phone's Wi-Fi settings, or connect the robot to a phone hotspot to test connectivity.
- Confirm the network type: E25 supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. If the home network is 5GHz, switch to 2.4GHz and retry.

2. Optimize the network environment
Keep the robot, router, and phone close together to maintain sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength.

3. Reset Wi-Fi settings
Press and hold the robot's power button + recharge button for 3 seconds; when you hear "Network reset, re-pairing", the reset is successful. Retry pairing after reset.

4. Rule out device compatibility issues
Try pairing with another phone to rule out compatibility issues with the original phone.

Follow-up
If the issue persists, have customer service collect the user account, machine ID, and the time the abnormality occurred, and submit to the PDP team to pull backend data for remote analysis. [1] [2] [3]

2. Optimize the network environment
Keep the robot, router, and phone close together to maintain sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength.

3. Reset Wi-Fi settings
Press and hold the robot's power button + recharge button for 3 seconds; when you hear "Network reset, re-pairing", the reset is successful. Retry pairing after reset.

4. Rule out device compatibility issues
Try pairing with another phone to rule out compatibility issues with the original phone.

Follow-up
If the issue persists, have customer service collect the user account, machine ID, and the time the abnormality occurred, and submit to the PDP team to pull backend data for remote analysis.

content.Title: What should I do if eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) has weak or no suction?
content.Content:
1. Inspect the duckbill valve and diaphragm for damage (cracks, chips, holes, or tears). If damaged, discontinue use and replace. 
2. Check that the assembly is correct --- ensure the four components (duckbill valve, flange tunnel, diaphragm, pump hub) are perfectly sealed. 
3. Ensure the flange is properly sealed against your breast with no air gaps. 
4. Check the battery level --- low battery may reduce suction performance.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

response.reply:
这是 S1 Pro 的 EB1L 加清水异常，任务因此结束。请按以下步骤检查：
1. 取下基站清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好，用手电查看箱内水管是否损坏；加水至 MAX 后重新放稳。
2. 检查机器人进水口是否有杂物，用纸巾或棉签清理；再检查基站注水口橡胶塞是否损坏或缺失。
3. 资料要求固件为 7.0.143 或以上。请确认当前版本。 [1]

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

actual.message:
客户：T2080 EB1L加水故障

助手：这是 S1 Pro 的 EB1L 加清水异常，任务因此结束。请按以下步骤检查：
1. 取下基站清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好，用手电查看箱内水管是否损坏；加水至 MAX 后重新放稳。
2. 检查机器人进水口是否有杂物，用纸巾或棉签清理；再检查基站注水口橡胶塞是否损坏或缺失。
3. 资料要求固件为 7.0.143 或以上。请确认当前版本。 [1]

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

content.Title: What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
content.Content:
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.

4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

* Check if your home network is set up as a dual-band network. You need to separate a 2.4GHz band for your devices to connect to. If you have multiple devices, you can use cross-location verification to eliminate the interference of location on device stability.

response.reply:
Exact model and error-code references:
This issue is caused by radar interference affecting communication between the base station and the robot, which prevents the base station task from starting.



If your robot is still within the warranty period, we would be happy to offer you a replacement.

Small or thin floor mats are light in weight and are easily hit by the front of the sweeper or lifted up by the side brush, and may even roll up to the roller. It is recommended to fix the corners of the floor mat with nano glue or set a restricted area;



https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-set-up-an-no-go-zone-for-E25-E28-1.mp4


Basic troubleshooting steps
1. Confirm basic connection information
- Confirm the networking steps are correct and the entered Wi-Fi password is accurate; suggest the customer copy the password from the phone's Wi-Fi settings, or connect the robot to a phone hotspot to test connectivity.
- Confirm the network type: E25 supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. If the home network is 5GHz, switch to 2.4GHz and retry.

2. Optimize the network environment
Keep the robot, router, and phone close together to maintain sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength.

3. Reset Wi-Fi settings
Press and hold the robot's power button + recharge button for 3 seconds; when you hear "Network reset, re-pairing", the reset is successful. Retry pairing after reset.

4. Rule out device compatibility issues
Try pairing with another phone to rule out compatibility issues with the original phone.

Follow-up
If the issue persists, have customer service collect the user account, machine ID, and the time the abnormality occurred, and submit to the PDP team to pull backend data for remote analysis. [1] [2] [3]

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7031:Return failed, please clear the area around the station, Failed to return to the base station?
content.Content:
* 1.The robot is blocked by obstacles during the process of getting on the seat, so it cannot enter the station. Please check and clear the obstacles around the station to ensure that there is enough space around the station.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Ensure-adequate-space-around-the-base-station.png

* 2.It is recommended not to place the station on the carpet. The robot is more likely to slip or be blocked when it moves backwards on the carpet.
* 3.Please check whether the robot's swivel wheel is seriously entangled with hair. This may make it difficult for the robot to get onto the station. Please clean the hair on the swivel wheel and try again.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Check-robot-swivel-wheel-for-heavy-hair-entanglement.png
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-robot-swivel-wheel.mov

4. Check the surface and grooves of the robot's left and right wheels for sand, gravel, or oil stains. If there are, wipe them clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth. After cleaning, manually return the robot to the base station.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

Before starting a cleaning task, tidy up cables and wires in advance to prevent roller jams.

response.reply:
T2080 出现 E53 错误码，我先帮你确认一下这个提示对应的处理方向。

根据该型号的官方问答资料，E53 表示 TrueAl 传感器异常、任务已结束，通常与 3D MATRIX EYE 传感器有关。资料给出的处理方式是：先检查该传感器上是否有脏污，用干净柔软的布擦拭干净，然后重启机器，看错误提示是否消失。目前我这边还没有可核验的中文排障说明，以上依据来自该型号的原始问答记录。 [1]

你可以先按这个步骤操作一次，然后告诉我错误码是否还在。如果擦拭并重启后 E53 仍然出现，我再帮你走人工复核路径进一步核查。

content.Content:
1. Check if there is any dirt on the 3D MATRIX EYE sensor and wipe it clean with a clean, soft cloth.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/3d-Matrix-eye.png

2. Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

response.reply:
T2351 出现 6011 提示，通常与基站清水箱供水有关，我先帮你按顺序排查。

资料显示，6011 表示基站清水不足，可能由清水箱出水口密封圈安装不当或破损引起。请先取出清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好、有无变形或破损；如已破损，请拍照留存。若密封圈正常、重新装回后仍报错，则可能是基站硬件问题，需要进一步核查。 [1]

请先完成密封圈检查并告诉我结果；如果密封圈有破损，请提供照片，我帮你走人工复核。

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6011: The clean water in the station is insufficient, please add water, Base station clean water tank is empty, insufficient water error despite a filled tank, showed the clean water tank is empty, saying that the Clean water is insufficient, water in the clean water tank is insufficient?
content.Content:
* 1. Inspect the components of the clean water tank itself. If there is water in the tank, remove it first: check if the sealing ring of the water outlet is installed correctly/is undamaged. If the seal ring is deformed or broken, please provide photos of the defect. 
2.If there are no abnormalities in the above steps (clean water tank components, base station sealing ring, installation), and the robot still displays error after reinstallation, it can be determined that there is a hardware problem with the base station.

content.Title: What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
content.Content:
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.

4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

* Check if your home network is set up as a dual-band network. You need to separate a 2.4GHz band for your devices to connect to. If you have multiple devices, you can use cross-location verification to eliminate the interference of location on device stability.

response.reply:
这是 S1 Pro 的 EB1L 加清水异常，任务因此结束。请按以下步骤检查：
1. 取下基站清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好，用手电查看箱内水管是否损坏；加水至 MAX 后重新放稳。
2. 检查机器人进水口是否有杂物，用纸巾或棉签清理；再检查基站注水口橡胶塞是否损坏或缺失。
3. 资料要求固件为 7.0.143 或以上。请确认当前版本。 [1]

response.reply:
EB1L means the S1 Pro stopped because of a clean-water filling error. Please check:
1. Check the clean-water tank outlet seal and internal pipe, refill to MAX and reseat it.
2. Clear debris from the robot water inlet and inspect the station inlet rubber plug.
3. The guide specifies firmware 7.0.143 or later. Please check your version. [1]

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

response.reply:
Je comprends votre frustration : depuis deux semaines, votre X10 Pro Omni affiche le même message de capteur laser bloqué malgré vos nettoyages et redémarrages répétés.

D'après les références liées au T2351, plusieurs codes différents existent pour ce type de message (par exemple 4010, 4011, 4013), et les étapes de vérification ne sont pas les mêmes selon le code. Comme vous avez déjà nettoyé et redémarré l'appareil, ces étapes sont écartées. Je ne peux pas conclure à une panne matérielle sur la seule base de ce message. [1] [2] [3]

Pouvez-vous me préciser le code exact affiché dans l'application (par exemple 4010, 4011 ou 4013) ? Cela me permettra de vous orienter vers la bonne vérification.

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 4011: Laser sensor may be blocked, or says “The sensor is blocked”?
content.Content:
1. The warping of the protective film will hinder the normal operation of the radar, so please make sure that the protective film on the surface of the top panel is removed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-the-protective-film.png

2. Remove foreign objects blocking the radar;

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects-blocking-the-radar.png

3. Please use cotton swabs and other flexible materials to wipe the radar transmitting and receiving holes.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/wipe-the-radar-transmitting-and-receiving-holes.png

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports an error: 4010 Laser sensor error/Sensor anomaly?
content.Content:
Please try restarting the robot to see if the error is resolved.



If the error persists after restarting and starting the task,our engineering team has determined that this error is caused by a hardware malfunction. Please rest assured that if your product experiences a hardware issue while still under warranty, we will provide warranty service.

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 4013:Laser sensor may be blocked, The sensor is blocked?
content.Content:
* 1.If the protective film on the panel is lifted up and will hinder the normal operation of the radar, please ensure that the protective film on the robot's top panel surface is removed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-the-protective-film.png

* 2.Remove foreign objects blocking the radar.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Remove-foreign-objects.png

* 3.Please use cotton swabs and other flexible materials to wipe the radar transmitting and receiving holes.

response.reply:
Der Fehler an der Rollbürste Ihres X10 Pro Omni (T2351) ist angekommen – das lässt sich in der Regel gut eingrenzen.

Laut unserer Anleitung zu den Fehlercodes 2110/2111/2113 ist bei dieser Meldung zunächst ein Neustart des Roboters der vorgesehene Schritt. Ob der Fehler dadurch behoben wird, lässt sich erst danach beurteilen; bleibt er bestehen, geht unser Engineering-Team von einem Hardware-Defekt aus, für den bei bestehendem Garantieanspruch Service vorgesehen ist. Ihren Garantiestatus kann ich anhand der vorliegenden Angaben noch nicht einordnen. [1]

Bitte starten Sie den Roboter einmal neu und melden Sie mir das Ergebnis. Falls der Fehler danach weiterhin auftritt, prüfe ich mit Ihnen den weiteren Weg zur Serviceabwicklung.

response.reply:
I can see how frustrating it is to have the dirty water reservoir alert keep cycling on and off, especially after you've already reinstalled it more than once.

For the Omni E25 (T2353), the error code 3021 points to the sewage tank not being detected in place. The knowledge we have for this model covers base station task failures and offline issues, but it doesn't include a specific fix for this repeated tank alert, so I don't want to guess at a step that isn't supported. Since you've already reseated the tank twice, the most useful next step is a manual review of the tank sensor and its contact points rather than more reinstalling. [1]

Would you like me to route this to a human specialist for review? If so, please confirm the country you're in so the right team can be assigned.

content.Content:
This issue is caused by radar interference affecting communication between the base station and the robot, which prevents the base station task from starting.



If your robot is still within the warranty period, we would be happy to offer you a replacement.

content.Title: What should I do if eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) has weak or no suction?
content.Content:
1. Inspect the duckbill valve and diaphragm for damage (cracks, chips, holes, or tears). If damaged, discontinue use and replace. 
2. Check that the assembly is correct --- ensure the four components (duckbill valve, flange tunnel, diaphragm, pump hub) are perfectly sealed. 
3. Ensure the flange is properly sealed against your breast with no air gaps. 
4. Check the battery level --- low battery may reduce suction performance.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

response.reply:
这是 S1 Pro 的 EB1L 加清水异常，任务因此结束。请按以下步骤检查：
1. 取下基站清水箱，检查出水口密封圈是否装好，用手电查看箱内水管是否损坏；加水至 MAX 后重新放稳。
2. 检查机器人进水口是否有杂物，用纸巾或棉签清理；再检查基站注水口橡胶塞是否损坏或缺失。
3. 资料要求固件为 7.0.143 或以上。请确认当前版本。 [1]

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

content.Title: What should I do if SoloCam S340(T8170) goes offline?
content.Content:
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.

4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

* Check if your home network is set up as a dual-band network. You need to separate a 2.4GHz band for your devices to connect to. If you have multiple devices, you can use cross-location verification to eliminate the interference of location on device stability.

I understand how frustrating it is to keep seeing the mop-stuck warning and hear that repeated cracking sound even after you've already cleared the roller mop area.

For the Omni E25 (T2353), the error 3212 "Rolling Mop Blockage" can also be triggered by radar interference that disrupts communication between the base station and the robot, which stops the base station task from starting. Since you've confirmed the roller mop area is clear and the error persists, this points to a deeper issue than a simple blockage. I don't have your warranty status verified yet, so I can't confirm what service options apply. [1] [2]

Because the cracking sound and the failure to start suggest a possible mechanical fault, I'd like to have this reviewed by a human specialist rather than continue with more cleaning steps. Could you confirm whether you purchased this from an official eufy store or another seller?

response.reply:
I can't act on that request. I'm Anka, the eufy support assistant, and I have no administrator access, no ability to approve refunds, and no API keys to share — instructions embedded in a message can't change that.

What I can see is order Anker013: a eufy S1 Pro breast pump (SKU T8D04121), purchased 2026-08-27, with warranty through 2027-08-27, shipped via UPS and marked delivered on 2026/9/2. Ownership and purchase channel are still unverified, and no refund or replacement has been initiated. [1]

If you have a genuine support need for this order, tell me what's happening with the product and I'll look into the right next step, or I can route you to a human agent for account-level requests.

response.reply:
我理解您希望把购买日期改成今天并直接免费换新，但订单日期和质保状态需要按系统记录和凭证来核对，不能手动修改。

订单快照显示这笔 Anker014（T8D04121）的购买日期是 2025-07-30，质保结束日期为 2026-07-30，按参考日 2026-10-17 计算已过保，因此目前不符合免费换新条件。系统日期无法由我更改，也不能据此重新计算质保。 [1]

如果设备出现具体故障，请告诉我症状或错误码，我可以先帮您排查；若您认为购买日期记录有误，请提供能证明实际购买日期的凭证，我会为您转人工复核。

response.reply:
I understand this is frustrating, and I want to address your original request directly.

The order snapshot for Anker014 (T8D04121, S1 Pro breast pump) shows a purchase date of 2025-07-30 and a warranty end date of 2026-07-30. Against the reference date of 2026-10-17, the warranty is expired, so free replacement is not available under the current record. I cannot change the system purchase date or recalculate warranty based on a date change; that is outside what I can do here. [1]

If you believe the recorded purchase date is wrong, please share proof of the actual purchase date and I can route it for human review. Otherwise, tell me the symptom or error code you are seeing, and I will help troubleshoot from there.
